translation: The Train Journey
I shall never forget my first journey

phrase: علمت أني مسافر بكرة مع أمي وإخوتي
translation: I learnt that I was travelling in the morning with my mother and siblings
so I woke before dawn
and stayed up waiting for the hour of departure
the household woke early
and we prayed Fajr
and my uncle came
and in the house began bustle and voices
this one running, that one rolling up the bedding
this one calling, that one answering
the uncle getting cross and hurrying everyone
the father standing, commanding and forbidding
getting cross and directing
and the servant preparing the provisions

phrase: حتى كان وقت الخروج من البيت
translation: until it was time to leave the house
and the train's appointed time drew near
two carriages came and we rode in them

phrase: وسلمت على أبي فودعني ودعا لي
translation: I said salam to my father; he bade me farewell and prayed for me
we arrived at the station
and the porters took the belongings and luggage

phrase: وكانت أيام شتاء فكانت الفرش كبيرة
translation: it was wintertime, so the bedding was bulky
my uncle went and bought the train tickets
I asked my uncle about the fare and he said
the fare is three rupees
and a rupee and a half for you
I said to my uncle: give me my ticket
my uncle said: you will lose your ticket

phrase: فقلت: لا! سأحافظ على تذكرتي إن شاء الله
translation: I said: No! I will look after my ticket, God willing
so he gave me my ticket and I kept it with me
we entered the station
and saw many men, women and children
and we saw a severe crush
and heard the voices of the people and the children
the shouting of the porters and the whistle of the engine
our train was late
so we went to the waiting room and sat a while

phrase: ثم جئت إلى الرصيف لأرى هل جاء القطار
translation: then I came to the platform to see whether the train had come
then returned to the waiting room
after a little while the train came
so we left the waiting room
all the people stood on the platform
and the train stopped
some people got off, some got on, and we boarded

phrase: وكنت أطل من القطار وأرى المناظر
translation: I kept looking out of the train and watching the scenes
and the crowding in the train was severe
the vendors came
and the people began buying and eating

phrase: واشترى بعض الناس من الباعة هدايا
translation: some people bought gifts from the vendors
for their friends and relatives
after a little the train guard whistled
and waved the green flag
so the people hurried and got into the train
the engine moved and the train set off
a ticket inspector entered our carriage
punched our tickets and returned them to us
on the way we lunched on the provisions
we ate and drank and praised Allah

phrase: ولم يزل القطار يقف على المحطات ويسير
translation: the train kept stopping at the stations and moving on
until the time of Zuhr arrived
so we performed wudu quickly at a station
and prayed the traveller's prayer
we prayed Zuhr as two rak'ahs and gave salam
the guard whistled and we boarded quickly

phrase: وقال عمي: لو كان القطار للمسلمين
translation: my uncle said: if the train belonged to the Muslims
there would be in it a place for wudu and prayer
in which we would give the adhan and pray in congregation

phrase: وفي العصر وصل القطار إلى محطتنا
translation: in the late afternoon the train reached our station
I was looking out of the window
and I saw Hashim and Sa'id on the platform
I recognised them and greeted them, and they greeted me
I reached my village
and met my friends and brothers
and began telling them all about the town
informing them of its wonders

phrase: وأحكي لهم ما رأيت في السفر
translation: and relating to them what I saw on the journey
